source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue developing useful LeanFrontier machinery toward eventual work on the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. Building on the orientation-sensitive coordinate modular root, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the rational-reconstruction step that makes the remaining quantitative obstruction explicit. For two ordered primitive positive coordinate pairs, equality of ratios modulo a Markov number means that the modulus divides their cross determinant u1*v2-u2*v1. If the determinant has absolute value strictly below the modulus, divisibility forces it to vanish; positivity and coprimality then force the two pairs to coincide. The module packages that implication and the elementary bound that every non-back coordinate is below the Markov-number coordinate. This does not establish the required small-determinant estimate for arbitrary same-label nodes and therefore does not prove Markov uniqueness; instead it isolates a concrete inequality sufficient for coordinate recovery. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and authored all definitions, statements, and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
